bindings.caption: E. tef grains were washed repeatedly with distilled water. Recipe-level reported vessel: hydrothermal reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

E. tef powder was mixed with de-ionized water. Recipe-level reported vessel: hydrothermal reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

The solution was heated in a hydrothermal reactor. temperature: 200 °C. duration: 6 h. Recipe-level reported vessel: hydrothermal reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

The reactor was cooled to ambient temperature. Recipe-level reported vessel: hydrothermal reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
